title.narrative: Climate Smart Agriculture for a Resilient Coastal Bangladesh

description.narrative:
**Long-term impact:**
- Create ecologically sustainable food systems; - Water is used sustainably and equitably, ensuring the needs of all sectors and the environment; - Promote agricultural growth.
**Medium-term impact that will contribute to this:**
- Education system (TVET/HE) is of good quality, relevant and accessible (SDG 4) - Partnerships between persons and organisations are inclusive and sustainable (SDG 17) - Organisations key to (sectoral) inclusive development of partner countries are strengthened by inflow of enhanced workforce.

comment.narrative: 17-11-2020: The curriculum for the new MSc program at PSTU is being developed. The program is almost complete, only 8 elective courses needs to be decided on. Currently, the curriculum is in the process of approval by the University Grant Commission of PSTU. After approval , the content of the courses will be developed.

title.narrative: A.S.1. Number of beneficiaries in the society reached with knowledge, skills and techniques

comment.narrative: 17-11-2020: Different organisation were reached during the inception workshop in Bangladesh, the learned about the concept of CSA and how the can benefit from and contribute to the project.

title.narrative: A.E.3. Number of staff that have gained qualitative and relevant knowledge and skills to develop and offer the revised/developed study programmes

comment.narrative: 17-11-2020: Five staff members have received intensive training (2 PhD positions; 3 post-doc positions); The recruitment of new post-docs is postponed, until there is more certainty regarding the COVID-19 regulations and travel restrictions.

title.narrative: number of short courses

comment.narrative: 17-11-2020: In the reporting period, an inception workshop has taken place in Bangladesh. During the inception workshop presentation were given by the different project partners explaining the CSA concept and how to implement CSA interventions. Besides, there was a local staff training planned at PSTU in June 2020, however it was cancelled due to Covid. Instead, we organize webinar series (12 webinars) between june 2020 - december 2020 for PSTU staff and students. One webinar has taken place in the reporting period. 20 PSTU teaching staff and 14 PSTU students attended the first webinar. From 2021, teacher trainings about CSA related topics will start. These trainings will be (partly) online, dependent on the COVID-19 situation. The aim of the teacher trainings is to prepare PSTU staff for teaching at the CSA master. Additionally, there will be a training organized on curriculum development.

title.narrative: A.O.8. % of women of teaching staff of faculty/department

comment.narrative: 17-11-2020: PSTU aims to increase the number of female staff. However, there is not always a suitable candidate available. Also, since PSTU is quite remote, some of the female staff had to leave their job for a job at another university.

title.narrative: A.S.3. Number of students performing an internship or practical work

comment.narrative: 17-11-2020: The MSc program on CSA has not started yet. So, in that context no student has performed an internship or practical work. However, a few PhD projects, post-doc researches and collaborative researches are starting up. We are trying to engage students from both PSTU and WUR in these projects too. title.narrative: A.O.6. Number of facilities established/strengthened

comment.narrative: 17-11-2020: There is local consultant appointed to assess the needs in terms of facilities of PSTU for the CSA master and research institutes. Based on this assessment, new facilities will be established and/or strengthened.

title.narrative: number of assessments of labour market needs

comment.narrative: 17-11-2020: consultant is appointed, assessment is in pocess. There is a dual reason why the assessment is still in process: 1. It was not straightforward to formulate the assignment, as the labour market for CSA is new and recently developing. It took some time to establish the focus; 2. The covid situation created delay.
